TWITTER_SPACES_ENABLE.description: Flag indicating whether the agent is allowed to join Twitter Spaces.

MAX_RETRIES.description: Maximum number of times the system will attempt to log in to Twitter before giving up

TWITTER_USERNAME.description: Twitter account username used for authentication

TWITTER_PASSWORD.description: Twitter account password used for authentication

TWITTER_EMAIL.description: Email address associated with the Twitter account; used during login/verification

TWITTER_2FA_SECRET.description: Time-based one-time password (2FA) secret used for two-factor authentication during login

TWITTER_COOKIES_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Pre-existing Twitter auth_token cookie value used to bypass manual login

TWITTER_COOKIES_CT0.description: Pre-existing Twitter ct0 (CSRF) cookie value used to bypass manual login

TWITTER_COOKIES_GUEST_ID.description: Pre-existing Twitter guest_id cookie value used to bypass manual login

TWITTER_API_KEY.description: Twitter API key used to authenticate with the Twitter API during tests.

TWITTER_API_SECRET_KEY.description: Twitter API secret key paired with the API key for authentication.

TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: OAuth access token used for Twitter API requests in the tests.

TWITTER_ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET.description: OAuth access token secret used with the access token for authentication.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key supplied to the SttTtsPlugin for GPT/STT/TTS functionality.

ELEVENLABS_API_KEY.description: ElevenLabs API key for TTS provided to the SttTtsPlugin. Used if ELEVENLABS_XI_API_KEY is not set.

ELEVENLABS_XI_API_KEY.description: Alternative ElevenLabs (Xi) API key for TTS; used as a fallback if ELEVENLABS_API_KEY is not provided.

PROXY_URL.description: URL of the proxy server (may include credentials) through which HTTP requests are routed.

TWITTER_COOKIES.description: Serialized Twitter session cookies; referenced for cookie-based authentication.

TWITTER_DRY_RUN.description: When true, all Twitter actions are simulated and nothing is actually posted.

TWITTER_RETRY_LIMIT.description: Maximum number of retry attempts when a Twitter action fails.

TWITTER_POLL_INTERVAL.description: Polling interval in seconds between checks for new Twitter events.

TWITTER_TARGET_USERS.description: Comma-separated list of Twitter usernames the bot should interact with. Supports '*' wildcard.

TWITTER_ENABLE_POST_GENERATION.description: Toggle to enable or disable automatic tweet/post generation.

TWITTER_POST_INTERVAL_MIN.description: Minimum interval in minutes between automatically generated posts.

TWITTER_POST_INTERVAL_MAX.description: Maximum interval in minutes between automatically generated posts.

TWITTER_POST_IMMEDIATELY.description: If true, posts are published immediately after generation, bypassing interval checks.

TWITTER_INTERACTION_ENABLE.description: Controls whether mention and interaction handling is enabled. Defaults to true when not explicitly set to false.

TWITTER_TIMELINE_ENABLE.description: Enables fetching and caching of the Twitter timeline.

TWITTER_API_SECRET.description: Twitter API secret credential (referenced in comments for future API-based auth).

TWITTER_ENABLE_ACTION_PROCESSING.description: Flag to enable or disable processing of Twitter actions

TWITTER_TIMELINE_MODE.description: Specifies which Twitter timeline to monitor: 'foryou' (home) or 'following'.

TWITTER_TIMELINE_POLL_INTERVAL.description: Polling interval (in seconds) between timeline checks.
